originalTitle: Trump’s press secretary Karoline Leavitt leaving role, president says – US politics live
summary: Donald Trump says Leavitt is leaving to spend more time with her family and would become one of his ‘top outside advisors’
content: The US military is “dangerously low” on missiles used in the US-Israel war on Iran, according to an analysis from Bloomberg Economics. The outlet’s reporting estimates that the US has likely fired more than half of its most advanced Patriot air defense interceptors and about 40% of its Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD) interceptors to defend US defended forces from retaliatory attacks by Iran during the conflict Donald Trump launched on 28 February. Democratic socialist Francesca Hong was on course to win the party’s nomination for Wisconsin governor on Wednesday by a clear margin, according to the polls – presaging the latest in an extraordinary wave of leftwing victories across the country, challenging the party’s establishment. It was not to be. In a photo finish after a messy campaign, David Crowley eked out a win by a few thousand votes over Hong, raising questions over the limits of the progressive movement that has swept through Democratic contests in recent months. Crowley, the Milwaukee county executive, had exited the race in early July, only to re-enter late in the month, with the backing of the outgoing Democratic governor, Tony Evers. The two barnstormed the state, consolidating support from a more moderate chunk of undecided voters, many of whom believed Crowley would more easily win November’s general election over the Republican Tom Tiffany. The stakes for the governor’s race are high, both locally and nationally. Tiffany voted against certifying the 2020 election, and Wisconsin is a key part of the presidential electoral map. And Democrats want a governing trifecta after years of a split government so they can enact a more expansive agenda. Those high stakes resonated with voters in a place where statewide elections are frequently decided by decimal points. Hong was seen as more of a gamble – and it didn’t help that when some voters just started paying attention, they found headlines focused on old tweets about canceling Thanksgiving or defunding the police, putting Hong on the defensive. The White House said that Donald Trump signed a national security presidential memorandum (NSPM) on ⁠Wednesday aimed at empowering federal law enforcement to ⁠use cyber tools against transnational criminal organizations that operate in foreign ⁠jurisdictions to attack Americans. Trump signed the memorandum directing ‌his administration to “leverage ‌the capability and innovation of the private ‌sector to help conduct these cyber operations under the direction, control, and authority of” the US government, the White House said in a fact sheet. The White House cited ransomware attacks, financial frauds and other crimes run by foreign-based organized criminal organizations. The memo creates a framework that encourages private sector companies to enter into agreements with ⁠other private entities, as well as federal, state, local, tribal and territorial agencies, to gather threat information on transnational criminal ‌organizations and propose cyber operations to address those threats, the White House added. When Karoline Leavitt appeared in the White House briefing room for the first time as press secretary, on 28 January 2025, she adhered to what was then a longstanding tradition and called on the Associated Press to ask the first question. Zeke Miller, then the AP’s White House correspondent, asked Leavitt what he called “a question that we’ve asked your predecessors of both parties in this job”. “When you’re up here in this briefing room speaking to the American public, do you view yourself and your role as speaking on, advocating on behalf of the president, or providing the unvarnished truth? That is, you know, not to lie, not to obfuscate to the American people?” “I commit to telling the truth from this podium every single day,” Leavitt replied. “I would like to point out, while I vow to provide the truth from this podium, we ask that all of you in this room hold yourselves to that same standard. “We know for a fact there have been lies that have been pushed by many legacy media outlets in this country about this president, about his family, and we will not accept that,” she went on. “We will call you out when we feel that your reporting is wrong or there is misinformation about this White House. “So, yes, I will hold myself to the truth, and I expect everyone in this room to do the same.” Just five minutes later, Leavitt told the assembled reporters, and the American people, a wildly false story to justify Trump’s sweeping order to freeze federal funding by citing what she called important new research from Elon Musk’s “department of government efficiency” (or Doge), and the office of management and budget (OMB). “Doge and OMB also found that there was about to be 50m taxpayer dollars that went out the door to fund condoms in Gaza,” Leavitt claimed. “That is a preposterous waste of taxpayer money. So that’s what this pause is focused on: being good stewards of tax dollars”. While Leavitt did not offer any evidence to support this claim, and was not pressed to by reporters in the room, the idea that the United States government had budgeted $50m to send condoms to Gaza quickly went viral, with an assist from Musk and the Fox pundit Jesse Watters, who claimed that day that the condoms were being used by Hamas militants as balloons to float explosives into Israel. However, as the Guardian reported later that day, a comprehensive report issued in September 2025 by the US Agency for International Development (USAID), showed that not a penny of the $60.8m in contraceptive and condom shipments funded by the US in the past year went to Gaza. In fact, no condoms were sent to any part of the Middle East, and just one small shipment, $45,680 in oral and injectable contraceptives, had been sent to the region, all of it distributed to the government of Jordan. chineseSummary: 唐纳德·特朗普表示，莱维特将离开，以便花更多时间陪伴家人，并将成为他的“顶级外部顾问”之一
chineseContent: 彭博经济研究公司的分析显示，美国军队在美以对伊朗战争中使用的导弹数量“严重不足”。该媒体的报道估计，在唐纳德·特朗普于 2 月 28 日发起的冲突期间，美国可能发射了一半以上最先进的爱国者防空拦截弹和约 40% 的末段高空区域防御 (THAAD) 拦截弹，以保护美国国防军免受伊朗的报复性攻击。民意调查显示，周三，民主社会主义者弗朗西斯卡·洪(Francesca Hong)有望以明显优势赢得该党威斯康星州州长提名 — — 预示着全国左翼胜利浪潮中的最新一波胜利，挑战了该党的建制派。事实并非如此。在混乱的竞选结束后的一张照片中，大卫·克劳利以几千票的优势战胜了洪，这引发了人们对近几个月席卷民主党竞选的进步运动的局限性的质疑。密尔沃基县行政长官克劳利于 7 月初退出竞选，但在即将卸任的民主党州长托尼·埃弗斯的支持下于月底重新加入竞选。两人在该州进行了巡回演讲，巩固了尚未做出决定的温和派选民的支持，其中许多人相信克劳利会更轻松地击败共和党人汤姆·蒂芙尼赢得 11 月大选。无论是在地方还是在全国范围内，州长竞选的风险都很高。蒂芙尼投票反对认证 2020 年选举，而威斯康星州是总统选举地图的关键部分。民主党希望在多年的分裂政府之后实现三连胜，这样他们就可以制定更广泛的议程。在全州选举经常由选民决定的地方，这些高风险引起了选民的共鸣。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
